sales_notes: Customer is mid-market (product analytics) with strong PLG motion — in-app assistant is top priority.
They started on Hosted to move quickly; after 6+ weeks they want Dedicated for cost predictability and lower p95 latency.
AE quote on call: "If we can hit predictable per-token cost and commit to a 6–12 month reserve, procurement will greenlight."
Budget: comfortable up to $150k ARR first year if SLA + residency boxes checked.
Buying process: technical sign-off from infra/security + finance procurement (2–3 week cycle once docs ready).
technical_summary: Primary model: warmed, medium-sized open LLM variants (re-ranking + chat). They prefer non-proprietary weights where possible.
Observed from Hosted trial: steady-state QPS 8–14 req/s, typical concurrency 12–28; peak spike observed ~62 QPS during campaign test.
Token mix from trial: prompt avg ~120 tokens, generation avg ~380 tokens => ~500 tokens/session average; 70% short-turn chats (<200 tokens), 30% long summaries/exports.
Monthly baseline token run-rate (extrapolated): ~250M tokens/mo. Peak month forecast (product launch): 500–700M tokens/mo.
Latency targets: p95 <= 300ms for short chat flows; p95 <= 1.2s acceptable for longer summarization tasks.
SLOs desired: 99.5% uptime + audit logs; auto-fallback allowed but must not impact UX during business hours.
Network: will require VPC peering + whitelist egress; security wants KMS key wrapping for model inputs in Dedicated.
detailed_forecast: MAU (current): 12k; projected 18k in 6 months post feature launch.
Avg tokens/session: 500 => baseline tokens/mo ~300M; expected peak ~600M.
QPS (baseline): 10 avg; concurrency target sizing: sustain 40 concurrent requests at p95 SLA.
Peak QPS (campaign): 70–85 QPS for short period (10–15 minutes bursts).
Capacity ask: Dedicated pool to sustain baseline with headroom — proposal: 4 x A100 (40GB) equiv for steady-state; autoscale to 8 GPUs for bursts.
Cost target: keep hosted-equivalent unit cost below $0.0008/token (their procurement threshold) with committed throughput discount.
poC_results: Hosted trial length: 6 weeks. Key wins: integration time <2 days, built-in streaming made UX parity simple.
Observed cost on Hosted: ~$0.0012 per token (varies by traffic pattern); dedicated estimate shows potential 30–45% cost reduction.
Performance: p50 ~120ms; p95 short-chat ~280ms on Hosted; during synthetic spike p95 degraded to 1.8s before fallback triggered.
Stability: a few throttles during north-of-60QPS spikes — need autoscale/fallback policy on Dedicated to avoid user-facing errors.
Requests for Redwood: confirm kernel+quantization config for chosen model, provide recommended batching window to meet latency targets.
decision_criteria: Must-have: SAML SSO + SOC2 compliance + audit logs and EU data residency option for EU customers.
Must-have: predictable committed pricing for 6–12 month term; price cap on per-token during bursts.
Nice-to-have: automatic prefix/KV caching demo and suggestions from Redwood Optimize for cost reduction.
Procurement: prefer 2 vendor quotes and a clear SLA appendix for Dedicated (latency, uptime, incident response).
